_comment: NPC-on-NPC fights (systems/brawls.js; on the street map ui/innerMapBrawls.js). Causes and their rates, how a fight climbs from words to blows, who joins, who breaks it up, the watch, death (rare, through systems/downed.js), grudges and what the town says after. Every roll is a hash stream of the world seed, the town and the day.

temper._comment: How quick a person is to fight, by their personality traits (multiplied; the hottest of a pair counts most).

causes._comment: base: chance a candidate pair comes to words at one look (on the map: one look every onMap.scanEvery seconds; off the map: weights of the day's fight). serious: may come to steel when someone is armed.

cutpurse.label: a cutpurse caught by their mark

drunk.label: a drunk spoiling for a fight

retainers.label: rival Houses' retainers
retainers._onMap: two Houses' retinues in the town the player walks: the day's chance their men clash in the street before the player (ui/innerMapBrawls.js), onMapMen a side

grudges._comment: Feuds between townsfolk (settlement.brawls.feuds, saved): what starts one, how hot, how fast it cools.
grudges._loveDays: rivalSuitor and affair grudges come only from real rivalries and affairs found out (systems/romance.js: folk.romance.grudges, the 'rivalInLove' / 'betrayed' logs) within loveDays; never a random pair.

cheated._note: only from a real bargain gone wrong or short weight (systems/townTrade.js grudge), never a random pair

escalation._comment: Words, then a shove, then fists; steel only when someone is armed and it is serious. Seconds per stage on the map; backDown: the chance they leave it there at the end of the stage.

death._comment: Death is rare: a knock-out may bleed (by stage), the bleeding may be bound by someone in time.

betting._bookie: A bookie stands up in the ring (ui/innerMapBrawls.js): once bookieRing onlookers are watching, bookieChance of fights (a hash of the fight) have one of them taking bets, the best-pursed grown-up in the crowd. Where gaming is forbidden (Laws.gambling) the Bet entries show greyed with the law's reason.

tavern: Say that again, I dare you.
I'll say it slower for you.
Your round, {name}. It's always your round.
Says the man who never pays.
grudge: Then you've a long memory and a short wit.
You've a nerve, showing your face, {name}.
drunk: I can take anyone in this town!
watch: In the name of the watch — stand!

cheer: A crown on the big one!
parted: Let go of me — I'm done.
watch: Break it up, in the name of the watch!
arrest: You'll cool off in the cells.
barred: And don't come back! You're barred!

rumours._comment: What the town says after ({a}, {b}, {place}, {when}). By outcome.
ko: {a} and {b} came to blows {place} {when}; {b} didn't get up for a while.
fled: {a} and {b} came to blows {place} {when}, and {b} ran for it.
{b} took a beating from {a} {place} {when} and fled.
parted: {a} and {b} came to blows {place} {when}, till folk pulled them apart.
There was a scrap {place} {when} — {a} and {b}, pulled apart before it went far.
watch: {a} and {b} were fighting {place} {when}; the watch took {a} away.
The watch broke up {a} and {b} {place} {when} and hauled {a} off.
joined: {a} and {b} came to blows {place} {when}, and a stranger waded in.
A stranger took a side when {a} and {b} fought {place} {when}.
death: {b} was killed in a fight with {a} {place} {when}. A terrible thing.
retainers: Men of {a} and {b} came to blows {place} {when}; there was blood in the street.
